Title: Private Right of Action Against a Social Media Platform
Summary: Creates a private right of action for the use of a design, algorithm, or feature by a social media platform that causes harm; imposes a civil penalty on a platform that knowingly and willfully contributes to the suicide or attempted suicide of a minor; provides that a platform is liable for an award of litigation costs, attorneys fees, and damages in an action brought by a parent or guardian whose child or legal dependent commits suicide or attempts suicide following exposure to certain online content.
Category: Private Sector Use; Private Right of Action

Title: Budget Act of 2025
Summary: Provides that the Budget Act of 2025 would make appropriations for the support of state government for the specified fiscal year. Amends the Budget Act of 2025 by amending, adding, and repealing items of appropriation and making other changes. Provides for the support of, among other things, the Legislative Analyst's Office, the State Court Facilities Construction Fund, the Judicial Branch, local assistance, and the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development.

Title: Bots: Disclosure
Summary: Requires a person who uses a bot to autonomously communicate with another to ensure that the bot discloses to any person with whom the bot communicates when the bot first communicates with the person that the bot is a bot and not a human being. Authorizes the attorney general, a district attorney, county counsel, city attorney, or city prosecutor to bring a civil action to punish noncompliance.
Category: Private Sector Use; Notification; Criminal Use

Title: Artificial Intelligence Technology
Summary: Provides that existing law creates a civil cause of action against any person who knowingly uses the name, voice, signature, photograph, or likeness of another person, without their consent, for specified purposes. Clarifies that, for purposes of this cause of action, a digital replication of a voice or likeness that a reasonable person would believe to be a genuine voice or likeness is deemed to be the voice or likeness of the person depicted.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Program: Attorney General
Summary: Requires the attorney general to establish and maintain a specified program to build internal expertise in AI, including its applications, risks, regulatory implications, and civil rights impacts. Requires, on or before the specified date, and annually thereafter, the attorney general to submit a public report to the Legislature describing the program, key developments in AI law and policy, and recommendations for additional State oversight or safeguards.

Title: State Bar of California
Summary: Provides that existing law requires certain revenue received from certain noninsurance and insurance affinity programs offered to licensees of the State Bar to go to the California Lawyers Association or an affiliated 501(c)(3) organization to support diversity, equity and inclusion. The bill would require the Committee of Bar Examiners to give notice if certain changes are made to the bar examination, including changing the functionality of testing software or materials, or if AI is used in creating questions for or grading the bar examination.

Title: California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
Summary: Enacts the California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025 to require a person, upon request of the attorney general, to provide to the attorney general information related to pricing algorithms. Requires specified officers to certify the accuracy of the report, subject to civil penalties. Prohibits a person from using or distributing any pricing algorithm that uses, incorporates, or was trained with, competitor data.

Title: Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act: Prohibition
Summary: Provides for the Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act, which would, in addition to any other law, prohibit a seller from using a price fixing algorithm to set either a price or supply level of a good or service or a rent or occupancy level of rental property. Authorizes the attorney general or a city attorney or county counsel to file a civil action for violations of these provisions, including for a civil penalty of up to a specified amount per violation.

Title: Automated Decision Systems
Summary: Relates to the State AI Transparency Act and providers of generative AI systems. Relates to regulating developers or deployers of a high-risk automated decision system. Requires a developer or a deployer to perform an impact assessment on the high-risk automated decision system before making it publicly available or deploying it. Authorizes the attorney general or the Civil Rights Department to bring a specified civil action to enforce compliance.
Category: Private Sector Use; Impact Assessment; Government Use

Title: Law Enforcement Agencies: Artificial Intelligence
Summary: Requires each law enforcement agency to maintain a policy to require an official report prepared by a law enforcement officer or any member of a law enforcement agency to include specified information on each page, including a disclosure statement, if the report was generated in a draft, interim, or final form using AI either fully or partially.

Title: Multistakeholder Regulatory Organizations
Summary: Provides that existing law requires the Department of Technology to conduct a comprehensive inventory of all high-risk automated decision systems that have been proposed for use, development, or procurement by, or are being used, developed, or procured by, a state agency. Establishes a process by which the attorney general designates a private entity as a multistakeholder regulatory organization. Requires an MRO to perform responsibilities related to certifying the safety of AI models.

Title: Electronic Discovery in Criminal Cases Task Force
Summary: Relates to the creation of the Electronic Discovery in Criminal Cases Task Force; provides that the task force consists of a specified number of task force members; provides that the purpose of the task force is to study the costs and management of electronic discovery in criminal cases.

Title: Insurance
Summary: Specifies that hurricane mitigation grants funded through the My Safe State Home Program may be awarded only under certain circumstances; revises the surplus required for certain insurers applying for their original certificates of authority and to maintain their certificates of authority, respectively; specifies prohibitions for persons who were officers or directors of an insolvent insurer, attorneys in fact of a reciprocal insurer.

Title: Information Technology
Summary: Creates the Agency for State Systems and Enterprise Technology; requires that the Division of Elections comprehensive risk assessment comply with the risk assessment methodology developed by asset; requires agencies and the judicial branch to include a cumulative inventory and a certain status report of specified projects with their legislative budget requests; revises the powers, duties, and functions of the Department of Management Services, through the State Digital Service.

Title: Technology Authority
Summary: Provides for an annual inventory of AI usage by state agencies; Provides for an annual inventory of AI usage by state agencies; provides for annual reports of such; provides for the authority to develop and establish certain policies; designates the attorney general as an applicable elected representative who may approve the issuance of certain private activity bonds to finance or refinance state charter school facilities; provides for the establishment of procedures for public notices and hearings relative to the issuance of such bonds.

Title: Election Interference
Summary: Establishes the criminal offenses of fraudulent election interference and solicitation of such; provides for exceptions; provides for the Attorney General to have concurrent jurisdiction over such crimes; provides for punishment; provides for injunctive relief; provides for the State Election Board to publish results of investigations into such offenses; provides for certain disclaimers on campaign advertisements that use AI generated media; provide for the form of such disclaimers.

Title: Rental Market Algorithmic Price Setting
Summary: Prohibits the use of algorithmic price setting in the state's rental market; requires the Department of the Attorney General to develop and undertake a public education program regarding the prohibition.
Category: Private Sector Use; Housing; Government Use

Title: Rental Price Fixing
Summary: Urges the Attorney General to investigate the extent to which algorithmic price setting and price fixing practices are being used in the state's rental housing market.

Title: Rental Price Fixing
Summary: Urges the Attorney General to investigate the extent to which algorithmic price setting and price fixing practices are being used in the state's rental housing market.

Title: Discriminatory Algorithmic Eligibility Determinations
Summary: Prohibits users of algorithmic decision making from utilizing algorithmic eligibility determinations in a discriminatory manner; requires users of algorithmic decision making to send corresponding notices to individual's whose personal information is used; requires users of algorithmic decision making to submit annual reports to the Department of the Attorney General; provides means of civil enforcement.
Category: Responsible Use; Private Sector Use; Notification; Housing; Effect on Labor/Employment

Title: Rental Market Algorithmic Price Setting
Summary: Prohibits the use of algorithmic price setting in the state's rental market; requires the Department of the Attorney General to develop and undertake a public education program regarding the prohibition; establishes fines and penalties.

Title: Large Developer
Summary: Changes references from developer to large developer; provides that a large developer that has one or more employees in the State shall not make, adopt, or enforce any rule, regulation, or policy preventing an employee from disclosing information to a government or law enforcement agency or any supervisor, principal officer, or board member related to an activity, policy, or practice of the large developer, where the employee has a good faith belief that the activity, policy.
Category: Responsible Use; Private Sector Use; Cybersecurity; Notification; Audit; Criminal Use

Title: Surveillance Based Price and Wage Discrimination Act
Summary: Creates the Surveillance-Based Price and Wage Discrimination Act; provides that a person shall not use surveillance data as part of an automated decision system to inform the individualized price assessed to a consumer for goods or services; provides that a person shall not use surveillance data as part of an automated decision system to inform the individualized wage paid to an employee; sets forth exemptions to the provisions; provides that the attorney general shall enforce the act.
Category: Private Sector Use; Effect on Labor/Employment; Responsible Use

Title: Technical Corrections
Summary: Addresses technical issues in the Indiana Code, including those related to spelling, tabulation, formatting, grammar, and cross-references; resolves technical conflicts from the 2024 legislative session; makes conforming amendments.

Title: Use of AI by Courts
Summary: Requests that the Supreme Court establish a pilot project to permit participating courts to use AI for court transcription services; establishes guidelines.

Title: Appropriations
Summary: Makes annual appropriations for Fiscal Year 2025-2026 for the ordinary expenses of the executive branch of state government, pensions, public schools, public roads, public charities, and state institutions and providing with respect to the expenditure of said appropriations. Includes appropriations to the Lafourche Parish District Attorney's Office for a partnership with Nicholls State University to enhance investigative capabilities using AI.

Title: Civil and Procedure
Summary: Prohibits an attorney from producing false evidence and including evidence that is artificially generated or altered by any means.

Title: Courts and Court Reporters
Summary: Provides for a study of court reporter per-page transcription rates in state and a study of digital court reporting, including using AI, as an alternative to traditional reporting.

Title: Processes and Fees in the Probate Court System
Summary: Updates processes and fees in the probate court system.

Title: Study on Detecting Deadly Weapons in Schools
Summary: Requires the State Center for School Safety to study how best to detect deadly weapons in public middle and high schools and how best to rapidly report the detection of weapons to a law enforcement agency; requires the State Center for School Safety to request any available assessment of the technologies evaluated under this Act.

Title: AI Evidence Clinic Pilot Program
Summary: Establishes an AI Evidence Clinic Pilot Program within the Administrative Office of the Courts to provide expertise in AI to the circuit courts and the District Court in the form of expert testimony on the authenticity of electronic evidence that a court determines may have been created or altered using AI; authorizes the Governor, for fiscal years 2027 and 2028, to include an appropriation of a specified amount in the annual budget bill.

Title: Building Information Guardrails Data Act of 2025
Summary: Establishes the Privacy Protection and Enforcement Unit within the Division of Consumer Protection in the Office of the Attorney General; establishes a data broker registry; requires certain data brokers to register each year with the Comptroller; imposes a tax on the gross income of certain data brokers for taxable years beginning after a specified date; requires the revenue from the data broker tax be used by Maryland Public Television to provide digital literacy support to students.
Category: Criminal Use; Private Sector Use; Responsible Use

Title: Howard County Study on Detecting Deadly Weapons
Summary: Requires the Howard County Board of Education to study how best to detect deadly weapons in Howard County public middle and high schools and how best to rapidly report the detection of weapons to a law enforcement agency; requires, by a specified date, in a manner that does not jeopardize school safety, the Howard County Board of Education to report on the findings of its study to the State Superintendent of Schools and the Howard County Delegation to the General Assembly.

Title: AI Evidence Clinic Pilot Program
Summary: Establishes an AI Evidence Clinic Pilot Program within the Administrative Office of the Courts; requires the Administrative Office of the Courts to develop a grant application for the Program and award grants to eligible institutions of higher education; authorizes the Governor to include in the annual budget bill an appropriation to the Program and establishing a certain limitation on the expenditure of appropriated funds.

Title: Building Information Guardrails Data Act of 2025
Summary: Establishes the Privacy Protection and Enforcement Unit within the Division of Consumer Protection in the Office of the Attorney General; establishes a data broker registry; requires certain data brokers to register each year with the Comptroller; imposes a tax on the gross income of certain data brokers for taxable years beginning after a specified date.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Models
Summary: Provides for requirements and safety standards for developers of certain AI models.
Category: Responsible Use; Judicial Use; Private Sector Use; Cybersecurity; Audit

Title: Victims of Crime Account
Summary: Establishes Minnesota Victims of Crime Account; provides for law enforcement agency registration with eTrace System to provide firearm information; transfers financial crimes and fraud investigations to Financial Crimes and Fraud Section in Bureau of Criminal Apprehension; provides for crime of theft of public funds; provides for order for protection against financial exploitation of vulnerable adult; modifies statutory forms for garnishment.
Category: Child Pornography; Criminal Use; Government Use

Title: Crimes Against Children
Summary: Creates the offense of grooming of a child for a sexual offense; revises certain crimes to include a law enforcement officer whom the offender believed to be a child; revises the offense of sexual abuse of children to include computer generated child pornography; adds the offense of grooming of a child for a sexual offense to the definition of sexual offense; provides for penalties.

Title: AI Systems
Summary: Relates to AI systems; provides for the registration and regulation of AI companies by the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of the Attorney General; imposes certain requirements and restrictions upon certain persons engaged in certain activities relating to AI systems; requires the Department of Employment, Training and Rehabilitation to collect and report certain information relating to AI systems.

Title: Law Enforcement Artificial Intelligence Use
Summary: Requires attorney general to study use of AI for certain law enforcement purposes and issue report.

Title: Law Enforcement Facial Recognition Technology Use
Summary: Requires attorney general to study law enforcement use of facial recognition technology and issue report with recommendations for statewide policy.

Title: Artificial Intelligence
Summary: Sets rules and procedures for the admissibility of evidence created or processed by AI.

Title: Advanced AI Systems
Summary: Requires the collection of oaths of responsible use from users of certain generative or surveillance advanced AI systems by the operators of such systems, and transmission of such oaths to the attorney general.
Category: Responsible Use; Criminal Use; Private Sector Use

Title: Commission on Forensic Science
Summary: Updates the membership, powers, duties and procedures of the commission on forensic science; establishes the scientific advisory committee, the social justice, ethics, and equity assessment committee and the forensic analyst license advisory committee; makes conforming changes.
Category: Responsible Use; Studies; Judicial Use; Government Use

Title: School Safety Planning and Training
Summary: Relates to classroom safety mechanisms, emergency medical equipment, and evidence-based best practices for school safety planning and training.

Title: AI Frontier Models
Summary: Relates to the training and use of AI frontier models; provides that, before deploying a frontier model, the large developer of such model shall, among other things, implement a written safety and security protocol, grant the Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Services or the Attorney General access t the safety and security protocol, and implement appropriate safeguards to prevent unreasonable risk of critical harm; provides for civil actions and penalties for violations.
Category: Provenance; Criminal Use; Cybersecurity; Oversight/Governance; Responsible Use

Title: Division of Criminal Justice Services
Summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to formulate a protocol for the regulation of the use of AI and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations; restricts the use of AI-generated outputs in court.

Title: Operator of a Covered Platform
Summary: Requires an operator of a covered platform with at least 1 million users to ensure that its covered platform provides a process to allow law enforcement agencies to contact such covered platform, which shall include making available a staffed hotline for the purposes of receiving and responding to questions about search warrants, acknowledging receipt of search warrants; provides status updates on warrant compliance, and which shall provide continuous availability of such process.
Category: Private Sector Use; Criminal Use; Government Use; Judicial Use

Title: Certification of Filings Produced Using Generative AI
Summary: Amends the Civil Practice Law & Rules Law; requires certification of filings produced using generative AI; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative AI in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

Title: Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems
Summary: Regulates the development and use of certain AI systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination; requires independent audits of high risk ai systems; provides for enforcement by the attorney general as well as a private right of action.
Category: Audit; Private Sector Use; Responsible Use; Impact Assessment; Private Right of Action; Criminal Use

Title: Development and Use of AI Systems
Summary: Regulates the development and use of certain AI systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination; requires independent audits of high risk ai systems; provides for enforcement by the attorney general as well as a private right of action.
Category: Private Right of Action; Responsible Use; Audit

Title: Commission on Forensic Science
Summary: Updates the membership, powers, duties and procedures of the commission on forensic science; establishes the scientific advisory committee, the social justice, ethics, and equity assessment committee and the forensic analyst license advisory committee; makes conforming changes.
Category: Studies; Responsible Use; Judicial Use; Government Use

Title: Certification of Filings Produced Using Generative AI
Summary: Amends the Civil Practice Law & Rules Law; requires certification of filings produced using generative AI; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative AI in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

Title: Law Enforcement Agencies Staffed Hotline
Summary: Relates to requiring certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours.
Category: Private Sector Use; Government Use; Criminal Use

Title: Law Enforcement Use of a Drone or Robot
Summary: Relates to law enforcement use of a robot; provides that a law enforcement agency may not authorize the use of a robot to deploy a lethal weapon, unless the weapon is controlled remotely, cannot be activated autonomously, and is used to neutralize an inanimate object at risk of exploding or causing an immediate threat to public safety or property, among other things.

Title: Removal or Withholding of a Child
Summary: Relates to interference with court-ordered parenting time; creates a child custody review task force; provides for a legislative management report; provides a penalty.

Title: Amusements and Sports
Summary: Relates to amusements and sports; enacts the Supporting Affordability and Fairness with Every Bet Act of 2025 or the safe Bet Act; defines terms; provides prohibition on sports wagering; provides exceptions; authorizes Attorney General to bring civil action; provides that trial shall be by a jury; provides for civil penalties; provides for jurisdiction; directs state to submit application; provides information application shall include.

Title: Evidence
Summary: Relates to evidence; relates to testimony by experts; provides for AI expert testimony; relates to hearsay; provides for attacking and supporting creditability of AI expert testimony; provides an effective date.

Title: State Government
Summary: Relates to state government; creates the Citizen's Bill of Rights; provides short title; defines terms; restricts certain entities from taking certain actions relating to currency; guarantees certain rights for the use of gold and silver; restricts certain entities from taking certain actions relating to digital identification; prohibits certain entities from implementing a social credit score; prohibits certain entities from taking certain actions relating to medical procedures.
Category: Government Use; Private Sector Use; Effect on Labor/Employment; Judicial Use; Oversight/Governance

Title: Law Enforcement Interdiction Task Force
Summary: Establishes the Task Force on Law Enforcement Interdiction Against Financial Scams on the Elderly.

Title: Regulatory Provisions on AI Act
Summary: Establishes regulations to ensure the ethical development, integration, and deployment of high-risk AI systems, particularly those influencing consequential decisions in areas like employment, education, lending, housing, healthcare, and legal services. Requires developers, integrators, and deployers to use reasonable care to prevent algorithmic discrimination, implement risk management policies, conduct regular impact assessments, and provide transparency.
Category: Responsible Use; Private Sector Use; Impact Assessment; Notification

Title: Offense of Intentionally Disseminating Intimate Images
Summary: Defines necessary terms for the offense of unauthorized disclosure of intimate images; creates the offense of unauthorized disclosure of intimate images; provides graduated penalties; provides an exception for law enforcement under certain circumstances.

Title: Consumer Protection
Summary: Requires the office of the attorney general and reporter to submit to the chair of the house committee having jurisdiction over consumer protection and the chair of the commerce and labor committee of the senate a report on the number of investigations into violations of the Tennessee Consumer Protection Act of 1977 in which AI was used to effectuate an unfair or deceptive act or practice affecting the conduct of any trade or commerce between the specified date.

Title: Consumer Protection
Summary: Requires the office of the attorney general and reporter; submits to the Chair of the House Committee having jurisdiction over consumer protection and the Chair of the Commerce and Labor Committee of the senate a report on the number of investigations into violations of the State Consumer Protection Act of 1977 in which AI was used to effectuate an unfair or deceptive act or practice affecting the conduct of any trade or commerce between the specified date, and a specified date.

Title: Regulation of Digital Reporting By the Judicial Branch
Summary: Relates to the regulation of digital reporting by the Judicial Branch Certification Commission.

Title: Adult Probation and Parole Amendments
Summary: Amends provisions related to the Division of Adult Probation and Parole within the Department of Corrections; establishes the Division of Adult Probation and Parole; amends provisions regarding the responsibility of the Department of Corrections to supervise individuals on probation or parole.

Title: Automatic License Plate Reader Amendments
Summary: Modifies and establishes requirements for the use of automatic license plate reader systems; defines terms; provides for authorized uses for automatic license plate reader systems by law enforcement agencies; and other governmental entities; establishes reporting requirements regarding the use of automatic license plate reader systems for law enforcement agencies and other governmental entities.

Title: Law Enforcement Usage of AI
Summary: Requires a law enforcement agency to have a policy concerning the agency’s use of generative AI; requires a police report or other law enforcement record to include a disclaimer if the report or record was created wholly or partially by using generative AI; requires the author of a police report or law enforcement record that was created wholly or partially by using generative AI to certify that the author has read and reviewed the report or record for accuracy.

Title: Landlords Antitrust Lawsuit
Summary: Calls on the state Attorney General to join the antitrust lawsuit against RealPage and landlords engaged in alleged price fixing actions.

Title: AI Developer Act
Summary: Relates to AI Developer Act established; relates to civil penalty; creates operating standards for developers and deployers, as those terms are defined in the bill, relating to AI, including avoiding certain risks, protecting against discrimination, providing disclosures, and conducting impact assessments and provides that the Office of the Attorney General shall enforce the provisions of the bill.
Category: Private Sector Use; Impact Assessment ; Responsible Use; Health Use

Title: Criminal Justice Risk Assessments
Summary: Relates to criminal justice risk assessments; relates to human oversight; requires that the recommendations or predictions provided by any AI-based tool, defined in the bill, utilized for criminal justice purposes, including recommendations or predictions related to pretrial release, sentencing, probation, or parole, shall be reviewed and approved by a qualified human decision maker prior to using any such recommendations or predictions in making or informing a final decision.

Title: Law Enforcement Agencies
Summary: Relates to law-enforcement agencies; relates to use of certain technologies and interrogation practices; relates to forensic laboratory accreditation; directs the Department of Criminal Justice Services to establish a comprehensive framework for the use of generative AI (AI), machine learning systems, audiovisual surveillance technologies, and custodial and noncustodial interrogations of adults and juveniles by law-enforcement agencies.

Title: Custodial Interrogations
Summary: Relates to custodial interrogations; relates to false statements to a child prohibited; relates to inauthentic replica documents; prohibits law-enforcement officers from intentionally making false statements or materially misrepresenting any fact, including by use of inauthentic replica documents, prior to or during a custodial interrogation of a child to secure the cooperation, confession, or conviction of such child; defines inauthentic replica documents as any documents, including computer.

Title: Science Scientific Research
Summary: Supports science, scientific research, and evidence-based decision making.
Category: Education Use; Education/Training; Effect on Labor/Employment

Title: 4th Amendment Restoration Act
Summary: The purpose of this bill is to require law enforcement officers and political subdivision officials from irresponsibly utilizing certain surveillance technologies and AI facial recognition technologies, setting forth legislative findings, providing definitions, establishing parameters for the responsible and constitutional use of these technologies.
Concerns the use of AI or other machine assisted translation in court proceedings and of telephone or live audiovisual interpretation in criminal trials.

Title: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Court Proceedings
Summary: Concerns the use of AI or other machine assisted translation in court proceedings and of telephone or live audiovisual interpretation in criminal trials.
